text:
julia: quick design review notes for API key management. kept short. main asks: clear revoke consequences, avoid accidental rotate, show-secret a11y, and empty-state wording. figma link in thread.

mike: agree. rotate as primary nudges regen over delete, but we should reduce misclicks. propose a tiny inline confirm when Rotate is clicked: 'Issue new key and keep scopes? Confirm / Cancel'.

aisha: good. also add helper under scope chips: 'Rotation preserves scopes (Admin / Read / Embed-only)'. customers ask this often.

dan: a11y: show-secret toggle needs aria-label and state announcement. use aria-expanded + aria-live polite region announcing 'API secret revealed' / 'API secret hidden'.

sam: mobile: when slide-over is full screen, ensure primary actions are reachable above soft keyboard and respect safe-area. Copy button should be full-width on small screens.

julia: revoke modal copy needs to be explicit. suggestion: 'Revoking this key will immediately stop services using it. This action cannot be undone. This will be recorded in Audit logs.' Buttons: Cancel (neutral) and Revoke key (danger). add link: 'Run dependency scan'.

mike: copy-to-clipboard: aria-label 'Copy secret to clipboard' and toast 'Copied API key' with role=status and aria-live=polite. do not move focus to the toast.

dan: modal accessibility checklist: trap focus, aria-describedby for the revoke button referencing the consequence text, Escape closes modal.

aisha: empty state decision: Heading 'No API keys yet', CTA 'Create your first key', subcopy 'API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely.' include a short curl example.

julia: rotation flow one-time secret microcopy: 'This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store it in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value.' optional 'Download .env' as secondary action.

sam: no undo for revoke; legal wants explicit action recorded in Audit logs. instead surface recent audit entries.

julia: action items: julia updates figma with inline rotate confirm and revised modal copy; mike implements aria-live + copy toast and mobile safe-area; dan runs a11y pass; aisha consolidates copy and checks with legal; sam validates mobile layouts. will paste final copy here after figma update. thanks all :sparkles:
